text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for gathering here today! 
Let's do one more song!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait. Isn't that Silence Suzuka over 
there? She really is such a pretty girl!

text_block_list.name: Gathered Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Wait, why is Suzuka-chan performing in a 
live? A Winning Live is one thing, but...”

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, they're doing something fun over 
there! We've got time, let's go check it 
out!

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...Count me out. A Live is something 
meant for star Umamusume anyway."

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Watching it just makes it all too clear. 
The difference between them and those of 
us who can't win races—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's not true!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is a request to all of you! Let's put 
on a concert together to express our 
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Lives are something every horse girl looks 
up to! And when you think of a live, the 
Winning Live is the first that comes to 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A stage earned through fighting in serious 
races. That's why it's sparkling... and 
why we dream.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the girls who didn't get to stand 
in the center are training hard every 
single day too, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...*gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone works hard every day on their 
singing, dancing, and training, hoping to 
show it off in front of their fans 
someday.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco is all for the Winning Live system! 
I mean, that's part of the reason I looked 
up to live concerts in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, wouldn't it be wonderful to have a 
live event at the end of every year where 
anyone can express their gratitude to the 
fans through song and dance?!”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"So why don't we all pour our hearts out 
and convey our feelings? Not through 
anyone else, but directly to the fans in 
our own voices!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We'll sing with all our hearts, too! To 
show how much we want everyone's help.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"So, won't you join Falco and the others 
in reviving the Grand Live?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, don't you want to stop by the 
stage after all? I think... I might want 
to try singing together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“...Or, you know, something like that! 
A-Ahaha...”

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ............ ...Just a little bit, okay?

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Yup!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
............Error occurred. Their song got 
to me again...
